scenes.summary: The Valley IV crisis has been recently averted but Director Qin is getting overwhelmed by work. You decide to help her share some of the burden.

lines.text: I'll head over once I wrap things up here. Add this to my work schedule.
This injury accommodation report is out of date. I need the latest report.
As you can see ... we're hanging on. Barely.
I must verify the cleanup, staff housing, and supplies distribution at the Hub Base. Any delays on my part will affect everything else that follows.
You're helping? Oh, thank you so much. Our work pipeline is very complicated right now. Let me see if there's a place ——
Director Qin, the meeting is about to begin. Are you...
Apologies, Endmin. I'm afraid I have to leave for now. Feel free to look around, and ask Fiona if you have any questions. Again, I'm really sorry!
That's her schedule on the workstation... It looks incredibly packed.
She also made her schedule public to all Base personnel. You can take a look at it as well.
For emergencies. Some of these task requests were auto-generated from incoming distress calls. These tasks can really build up.
I've marked several high-priority issues that must be handled on-site. Director Qin is probably too busy to take care of them right now.
I'm sorry, Endministrator. There are just too many things on our hands right now.
I should be showing you around the place but...
*Sigh*... That's right. There's a pile of documents and files that I have to go through.
That wouldn't do. I am also in charge of drafting up work reports. I can't simply ignore my job.
Don't worry, I got the Endmin covered. Go ahead and do your thing, Director.
Okay ... great. I'm really glad you're taking the time to help us.

options: How are you managing, Director Qin?
Anything I can do to help?
She really needs an assistant to share her workload.
Does she have to stay on top of everything?
Time to share my colleague's burden.
It's alright. I have a good idea of the sitch.
I understand. You got other things to do, right?
It's alright. I can tour this place myself.
